summary.text: Steve C. Johnson is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates representing District 34A and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He serves on the House Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Johnson assumed office on January 9, 2019, succeeding Republican Glen Glass in District 34A, which covers part of Harford County.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.
According to Ballotpedia, he was assigned to the Health and Government Operations Committee in each term since 2019 and to the Audit and Evaluation Committee for 2023 through 2026.
He advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
